text:
- [RARC.2.4.2] **Co-locate tiers in one process** when an
  upstream tier consumes a downstream tier's emits
  inside the downstream tier's own cycle (tight-
  latency case). Direct in-process assertion via the
  integrator's RHS callback is the lightest path.
  See [LFAC] for the `ttl` /
  `logical` distinction that makes same-cycle
  consumption coherent.
